title.value: Deep Neural Networks pruning via the Structured Perspective Regularization
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote:
Deep Neural Networks pruning via the Structured
Perspective Regularization

extractions.description: The paper introduces a novel structured pruning method for Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) using Operational Research tools, specifically Mixed-Integer Programming (MIP) and Perspective Reformulation. This method aims to compress networks by removing entire elements (links, nodes, channels) while minimizing performance sacrifice, addressing the combinatorial challenge of element selection for pruning.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: While the paper discusses efficient machine learning, it does not directly focus on sustainable development themes.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote:
In Machine Learning, Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) are a very powerful
tool, broadly used in many applications. Often, the selected (deep) architectures
include many layers, and therefore a large amount of parameters, which makes
training, storage and inference expensive.
